sub_graphs.title: EIP-5656: MCOPY Opcode Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime behavior of the MCOPY (0x5E) opcode for efficient memory-to-memory copying

nodes.label: EVM Executing Bytecode
nodes.description: EVM is executing contract bytecode and encounters opcode 0x5E

nodes.label: Read MCOPY Opcode (0x5E)
nodes.description: EVM reads and decodes MCOPY opcode from bytecode

nodes.label: Pop Stack Arguments
nodes.description: Pop three arguments from stack: dst (destination), src (source), length

nodes.label: Arguments Retrieved
nodes.description: dst, src, and length values are available for operation

nodes.label: Calculate Words Copied
nodes.description: Compute: words_copied = (length + 31) // 32

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion
nodes.description: Determine if src+length or dst+length exceeds current memory size

nodes.label: Calculate Total Gas Cost
nodes.description: Compute: 3 + (3 * words_copied) + memory_expansion_cost

nodes.label: Gas Cost Determined
nodes.description: Total gas cost for MCOPY operation is known

nodes.label: Check Sufficient Gas
nodes.description: Verify remaining gas >= calculated gas cost

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Execution fails due to insufficient gas for MCOPY

nodes.label: Deduct Gas
nodes.description: Deduct calculated gas cost from remaining gas

nodes.label: Expand Memory If Needed
nodes.description: Extend memory with zero bytes if dst+length or src+length exceeds current size

nodes.label: Copy Memory Bytes
nodes.description: Copy length bytes from memory[src:src+length] to memory[dst:dst+length] as if using intermediate buffer

nodes.label: Memory Copy Complete
nodes.description: Memory region successfully copied, EVM continues execution

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5656: MCOPY Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas metering formula for MCOPY following W_copy cost category

nodes.label: MCOPY Gas Calculation Started
nodes.description: System begins calculating gas cost for MCOPY operation

nodes.label: Calculate Base Cost
nodes.description: Apply base cost of 3 gas (Gverylow)

nodes.label: Calculate Per-Word Copy Cost
nodes.description: Compute: 3 * ((length + 31) // 32) following Gcopy pricing

nodes.label: Calculate Current Memory Cost
nodes.description: Compute memory_cost(current_mem_size) using quadratic formula

nodes.label: Calculate New Memory Size
nodes.description: new_size = max(current_size, max(src+length, dst+length))

nodes.label: Calculate New Memory Cost
nodes.description: Compute memory_cost(new_mem_size) using quadratic formula

nodes.label: Calculate Expansion Cost Delta
nodes.description: expansion_cost = memory_cost(new_size) - memory_cost(current_size)

nodes.label: Sum Total Gas Cost
nodes.description: total = 3 + (3 * words_copied) + expansion_cost

nodes.label: MCOPY Gas Cost Computed
nodes.description: Final gas cost ready for deduction

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5656: Overlapping Memory Region Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models the safe handling of overlapping source and destination memory regions

nodes.label: Source/Destination May Overlap
nodes.description: Memory regions [src, src+length) and [dst, dst+length) may overlap

nodes.label: Determine Overlap Type
nodes.description: Check if regions overlap and which direction

nodes.label: No Overlap
nodes.description: Regions are disjoint, direct copy is safe

nodes.label: Forward Overlap (src < dst)
nodes.description: Source starts before destination with overlap

nodes.label: Backward Overlap (dst < src)
nodes.description: Destination starts before source with overlap

nodes.label: Copy As If Using Intermediate Buffer
nodes.description: Semantically copy all bytes atomically as if through temporary buffer

nodes.label: Correct Copy Result
nodes.description: Memory contains correct result regardless of overlap

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly document error conditions beyond gas exhaustion
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MCOPY only fails on out-of-gas. Stack underflow is handled by general EVM stack rules. Memory automatically expands.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'as if an intermediate buffer was used' describes semantics but not implementation requirement
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations may use any method (memmove, reverse copy, actual buffer) as long as the result matches buffered copy semantics.

implicit_assumptions.description: Implementations handle overlapping regions efficiently without actually allocating an intermediate buffer
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Naive implementations using actual buffers could create DoS vectors via memory allocation attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: The quadratic memory cost formula provides sufficient DoS protection for MCOPY operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If memory pricing is insufficient, attackers could exhaust node memory through large MCOPY operations

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas metering accurately reflects computational cost of memory copy operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced MCOPY could be used for resource exhaustion attacks against nodes
